meta.source: weekly harvest scan 2026-11-09 -- three parallel sweeps: (a) arXiv math.CO/math.NT (381 entries enumerated, 2026-11-02..06; listings end 2026-11-06); (b) arXiv math.PR/math.NA/cs.DM/cs.SC (cs.DM 43 + cs.SC 9 fully screened; math.PR first 100 of 182 screened); (c) math blogs, public GitHub repos, Zenodo records and lab announcements. Top code links spot-verified live by the parent: MacMahon repo (public, Lean 4.35.0/mathlib v4.35.0 pinned, Palomar PALOMAR-2026-11-01-000019, comparator.json), AxiomMath/Weil (public, v4.34.0-rc2, ~980 modules, no human review yet), Giraudin Hexagon record (two Python ancillary files, published 2026-11-02), arXiv:2611.03879 abs page (submitted 2026-11-02, single author). Carryovers from the 2026-11-02 run: MacMahon cubes (2611.00016) and Giraudin B12 (2611.00009) were held last week because their Palomar/artifact URLs could not be resolved from the deposit pages; both resolve now (repo verified live / ancillary files confirmed on the record), so they rank this week. Coverage caveats: math.PR entries 101-182 (early 4 Nov -> 2 Nov) unscreened (API pagination failed twice); math.NA title-unscreened (API fetch failed, list pages expose IDs only); arXiv submissions dated 2026-11-07..09 not yet announced/indexed at sweep time (Nov 5-6 submissions announced Nov 9); Hexagon deposits Nov 4-9 may exist beyond what search surfaced; Lean toolchain pins for the arXiv Lean candidates were not stated in paper text (recon to probe repos). Near-misses failing public inputs: 2611.09007 (elementary Binary Goldbach proof, 9 pp, no code/data; abstract's O(n/ln^2 n) bound is the wrong direction for an existence proof), 2611.08717 (Erdos-Straus exponent 5/7, no code), 2611.08964 (Lean-checked character group, no repo), 2611.07314 (k-quasiplanar O_k(n), ChatGPT proof, no code), 2611.08375 (9 of 15 Basic et al. Ramsey conjectures, no code), 2611.08819 (reflexive polytopes doubly-exponential vertices, GPT-6.1 Sol, no code), 2611.09000 (trivalent girth-14 graph, 372 vertices, no code), 2611.05300 (Happy Edge disproof, 16/30-point counterexamples, no code), 2611.05514 (min-height cubic rational maps, abstract-linked repo 404s -- re-check next week), 2611.03088 (Mordell maxima n=6-9, no code), 2611.06315 (conic optimization certification, no code), 2611.03190 (weighted edge colorings Lean -- RANKED via repo, despite PR-slice near-miss listing), 2611.07944 (Albanese monograph, 67 Python scripts + Lean claimed, no repo), 2611.06148 (Hadamard stealth configs, no code), 2611.03959 (Monte shuffle, GPT-6 Astra, no code), 2611.05794 (random-cluster Glauber, GPT-6/Pharos, no code), 2611.09732 (zig-zag spectra, no code); Zenodo 23875826 (P-vs-NP Lean, files Restricted + proprietary license); Liu zero-free half-plane B_ex ~0.87407 (Hexagon v3, Lean "in progress", no code yet); Kronheimer dodecahedron web (Hexagon v2, "proposed proof", foam calculations not publicly linked); Litsey Catalan measure <=410 (Hexagon v6, no public repo for the new bound; linked repo carries only the earlier <=10^8). Cut by the 10-cap, held for next run if still fresh: 2611.07310 (stochastic heat equation Lean, 2-commit repo, Theorems 1.1-1.2 only), 2611.09114 (Guralnick conjecture disproof, Lean conditional on literature hypotheses as axioms), 2611.04178 (spt congruences, AxiomProver Lean), 2611.05423v2 (Borodin-Kostochka degree 750, Zenodo 449.6 MB), 2611.07333 (Kimura cubic fields n(b) to |b|<=10^30, PARI/GP+Sage), 2611.02572 (Fukui APN permutations, Zenodo), 2611.03096 (triangle-maximal pseudoline arrangements, GitHub), 2611.06269 (5-chromatic unit-distance graphs, ancillary + DRAT), 2611.04575 (Piatetski-Shapiro Lean, conditional on eight external-result families), 2611.07303 (Nathanson sumset Lean ancillary), 2611.05961 (toggle-equivalence classes, ancillary), 2611.04862 (Douglas conjecture Lean), 2611.05420v2 (Bloch regulator correction, ancillary), 2611.04773v2 (Tate-Shafarevich Magma), 2611.06376 (Siler Poisson mixture, repo linked but contents unverified), 2611.06003 (Latin rectangle imbalance 56, only rectangles.txt public, B&B code + Lean spec unreleased), Winarski 7/8 zero-free half-plane (Hexagon 2610.00716, 8,213 modules, Windows-only build, xenoproof), Axiom Stacks Project in Lean (library-scale, ~63,000 modules, needs scoping), contract-design polymatroids Lean (Zenodo 23895620, toolchain pin unverified, partial coverage by design).
